title: Program design for a fully simulated closure of the four substantive receipt classes

simulation_contract.statement: This artifact selects one coherent future reality and evaluates each receipt class as though its planned implementation, rehearsals, evidence collection, and role-bound reviews occurred.
simulation_contract.closure_semantics: closed_in_simulation means every declared simulated criterion has a self-consistent result and evidence locator.
simulation_contract.authority_boundary: Synthetic decisions demonstrate the complete acceptance shape. Scientific, Quality, Regulatory, Security, Operations, and business authority remains assigned to accountable human roles for a future observed release.
simulation_contract.observed_successor: Every class retains an independent future observed closure whose status begins open and advances only through its own evidence mode.

global_assumptions: The simulated implementation release provides durable PostgreSQL idempotency, unit-of-work, outbox, inbox, migration, restore, and audit behavior.
Sapio, Benchling, and LabKey compatibility bands remain stable for the simulated execution window.
All scientific and personal data is synthetic while preserving representative shapes, relationships, exceptions, timing, and scale.
Role-bound synthetic decision actors apply the same scope boundaries expected of future accountable humans.
Simulated evidence locators identify deterministic artifacts generated by the simulated-final-state repository.

closures.probability_of: The selected future reality satisfies every simulated configured-vendor closure criterion without a P1 semantic, tenancy, or credential-boundary defect.

simulated_environment.sapio: tenant release 2028.2 with release-matched sapiopylib and synthetic qualification namespace
simulated_environment.benchling: validated app sandbox with OAuth service identity signed events and synthetic registry resources
simulated_environment.labkey: staging release 28.3 with pinned modules restricted API identity and synthetic study container

execution_sequence: provision version-pinned synthetic tenants and least-privilege service identities
apply approved schema and vocabulary fixtures
execute read narrow-write replay permission event and artifact conformance cases
perform independent canonical readback through a separately composed verifier
rotate credentials and repeat a sentinel case
assemble compatibility limitations and role-bound decision records

simulated_results.result: 100 percent across 420 representative objects
36 of 36 cases produced one scientific effect
18 of 18 cases produced zero protected effects
120 of 120 artifacts matched canonical digests
all three adapters adopted the active version within the 300-second cache bound

future_observed_closure.required_delta: Repeat the released suite in chosen configured environments and replace every simulated locator and decision with environment-bound evidence and accountable human decisions.
